tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Main canvas: the table, record page and board background. Ground for `text`, `text-secondary`.

tokens.name: surface-sidebar
tokens.usage: The left navigation column only.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers, modals, cards, secondary buttons. Sits one step above `surface` in dark; in light it is separated by `border-subtle` and a shadow instead.

tokens.name: surface-subtle
tokens.usage: Recessed strips: the record meta strip, modal footer, table footer row.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Tracks that something slides inside: the segmented control. Sits below `surface`, so the raised thumb reads in both themes.

tokens.name: surface-hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill for rows, nav items, menu items and ghost buttons.

tokens.name: surface-selected
tokens.usage: The current nav item, the highlighted menu or palette row.

tokens.name: surface-column
tokens.usage: Tint on the table column the view is sorted by.

tokens.name: border-subtle
tokens.usage: Table grid lines, section dividers, panel edges, input outlines. Separation only, never the sole boundary of a control.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Outline of buttons, chips, cards and menus, always paired with `shadow-control` or a shadow so the edge reads.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Hovered control outlines, empty rating stars.

tokens.name: control-border
tokens.usage: Outline of checkboxes and radios, the switch track when off, and the dashed Filter button: the boundary that identifies the control. 4.2:1 on `surface` and 3.6:1 on `surface-selected` light, 5.4:1 and 3.8:1 dark; at least 3.5:1 on every surface a control sits on, selected rows and cell ranges included (WCAG 1.4.11).

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on every surface token. 17.3:1 on `surface` light, 15.0:1 dark.

tokens.name: text-secondary
tokens.usage: Attribute labels, metadata, column-header icons, 'Sorted by'. 6.7:1 on `surface` light, 7.6:1 dark; at least 5.3:1 on `surface-selected` in both themes.

tokens.name: text-tertiary
tokens.usage: Placeholders ('Set Notes...'), empty values ('No contact'), footer calculations, days outside the month. 5.3:1 on `surface` and 4.5:1 on `surface-selected` light; 6.5:1 on `surface` and 4.5:1 on `surface-selected` dark, so it holds 4.5:1 on every surface, hovered and selected rows included.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Primary buttons, checked checkboxes and switches, filled rating stars, the unread badge. Under `on-accent` it holds 4.6:1 in both themes. As a mark on `surface` it is 4.6:1 light and 3.6:1 dark; for text use `link`.

tokens.name: accent-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed state of `accent` fills; the primary button's 1px edge. Darker than `accent` in both themes, so `on-accent` labels hold 6.2:1 light and 5.2:1 dark while hovered.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted ground behind `link` text: email and domain chips, the 'Preview' pill.

tokens.name: accent-border
tokens.usage: Outline of link chips on `accent-soft`.

tokens.name: accent-line
tokens.usage: Accent lines that must read on every surface, `surface-selected` included: the inset focus ring and a checked box's edge. 3.9:1 on `surface-selected` in both themes and more everywhere else (WCAG 1.4.11). Not for fills under `on-accent`: use `accent`.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Label and icon on an `accent` fill. 4.6:1 on `accent`.

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Link text: emails, domains, URLs. 6.3:1 on `surface`, 5.5:1 on `accent-soft` (light); 6.4:1 and 6.0:1 dark.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: 3px halo outside a focused control, drawn with box-shadow. Always paired with a 1px `accent` border, which carries the 3:1 contrast; the halo alone does not.

tokens.name: ai
tokens.usage: The sparkle on AI-computed attributes and actions. Icon only, never text.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Error text and icons, the invalid-field outline, destructive menu items. 5.3:1 on `surface` and 4.5:1 on `surface-selected` light; 7.0:1 on `surface` dark.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Success icons and text: the tick in a success toast, a saved or connected message. 5.3:1 on `surface`, 5.4:1 on `surface-raised` and 4.8:1 on `surface-hover` light; 7.6:1, 6.9:1 and 6.2:1 dark. Status dots and chart series keep `dot-green`.

tokens.name: dot-gray
tokens.usage: Status dot: no data or not started ('No communication', 'Prospecting'). Always beside a word.

tokens.name: dot-red
tokens.usage: Status dot: 'Very weak', lost, overdue. 3.1:1 on `surface` light: a mark beside a word, never alone.

tokens.name: dot-orange
tokens.usage: Status dot: 'Weak', at risk.

tokens.name: dot-yellow
tokens.usage: Status dot: 'Meeting', in progress.

tokens.name: dot-lime
tokens.usage: Status dot: early positive stage ('Qualification').

tokens.name: dot-green
tokens.usage: Status dot: 'Very strong', won, done. 2.3:1 on `surface` light: always beside a word.

tokens.name: dot-sky
tokens.usage: Status dot: a neutral in-flight stage ('Proposal').

tokens.name: dot-blue
tokens.usage: Status dot: a stage the team owns next ('Negotiation').

tokens.name: dot-purple
tokens.usage: Status dot: a late or special stage ('Offered').

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Section heading inside a record tab.

styles.name: note-title
styles.usage: The title of a note, and nothing else.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Page title in the top bar, record name, workspace name.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Nav items, buttons, column headers, menu items, record names in cells, the actor in an activity line.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Cell values, attribute values, descriptions, activity text.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Field labels in forms, attribute labels in the details panel, modal titles, section labels in the sidebar (weight 500).

styles.usage: Section labels in the sidebar (Favorites, Records, Lists): the label style at weight 500.

styles.name: kbd
styles.usage: Keycaps inside buttons, menus and the palette footer. Sans, so ⌘ and ↵ come from the system face.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Record IDs, API slugs, webhook payloads.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between a keycap pair; icon to count inside a badge.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Menu padding; gap between tags in a cell.

tokens.name: space-6

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Checkboxes, keycaps, count badges, company logos at 16px and below.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Tags, record and link chips, nav items, menu items, table cell editors.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, toolbar chips, kanban cards.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Menus and popovers.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Modals, the command palette, the floating record panel.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Person avatars, status dots, the switch.

tokens.name: shadow-xs
tokens.usage: Chips that act as buttons, kanban cards, the switch knob.

tokens.name: shadow-control
tokens.usage: Secondary buttons, keycaps and select triggers: a hairline keycap edge (bottom in light, top highlight in dark) plus a soft drop.

tokens.name: shadow-primary
tokens.usage: The primary button: a lit top edge, a darker bottom edge and a faint accent glow.

tokens.name: shadow-md
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers, toasts.

tokens.name: shadow-lg
tokens.usage: Modals, the command palette, the record side panel.

tokens.name: shadow-focus
tokens.usage: The 3px halo outside a focused control, in the `focus-ring` colour. Pair it with a 1px `accent` border, which carries the 3:1 contrast; combine with a control shadow as `var(--shadow-control), var(--shadow-focus)`.

tokens.name: shadow-focus-inset
tokens.usage: The 2px `accent-line` ring drawn inside a focused row, cell, tab, menu item, nav item or day: where an outer halo would be clipped or crowd its neighbours. It holds 3.9:1 on `surface-selected`, so a focused cell in a selected row still shows.

breakpoint.note: Lengths for @media (bp-page-*) and @container (bp-container-*) conditions. CSS variables cannot be used in a condition, so lint allows only these values there.

tokens.name: bp-page-compact
tokens.usage: Below this width the app shell uses its compact layout (the sidebar collapses). Nothing narrower is tailored; phones use the native apps.

tokens.name: bp-container-sm
tokens.usage: A region narrower than this stacks label above value (the details panel).

tokens.name: bp-container-md
tokens.usage: A region narrower than this wraps its rows (the filter builder).
